FAQ
Do you deliver?

We offer UPS 2-day shipping within Texas and we schedule local pick-ups in Dallas (Tuesday) and Waxahachie (Thursday) twice per month.

Can we split a whole cow with another family?

Absolutely! It's common for us to deliver a whole cow to 2 or more families.

Do you ever feed your cows grain?

Nope! They are grass fed and grass finished!

Do you vaccinate the cows?

Nope, they are all natural!

A full list of our beef cuts and products.
We primarily sell variety beef boxes, quarters, halves, and whole steers.
*Individual cuts for sale subject to vary.

Filet

8 oz. portions of the beef tenderloin. Prime, buttery cut.

STEAKS

Ribeye

Prime cut from the rib section. Known for it’s fat marbling and rich flavor. 1.25” thick.  

Tomahawk Ribeye

Bone-in ribeye. A fun cut for all grill lovers! 

New York Strip

A very tender, yet lean cut with a fat strip along the side. 

Sirloin

Sirloin comes from the  upper portion of the back-end and is the most tender and lean cut from that area. 

Flank

Cut from the abdominal region, the flank is a thin, lean cut great for a quick grill or sear.

Flat Iron

Comes from the shoulder blade. Flat iron is tender and flavorful. 

Skirt

A thin cut of beef from the chest and abdominal area. Great for a quick sear.

Tenderized Round

Comes from the rear end and is a thin, lean cut. It makes the perfect chicken fried steak or stir-fry!

Ranch Steak

Also known as the chuck roast center-cut steak. A very lean cut. 

Bavette

Similar to a flank steak or skirt. Bavette has layered marbling, tenderness, and full flavor.

SPECIALTY CUTS

Picanha

The top cap of the sirloin.

Brisket

Trimmed brisket. Average 4.5 lbs.

*We can do a whole, untrimmed brisket on request.

Tri Tip

Tri tip is a roast cut found on the bottom sirloin. Cook it in the oven or smoke it to lock in the juices.

Short Ribs

Large beef ribs. 

Flanken Ribs

Beef Short Ribs that are cut thinly across the bone. Full of flavor and perfect for braising or throwing on the grill!

Osso Bucco

Full flavor beef with the marrow bone in the center. Perfect slow-cooked cut or a great addition to bone broth

Stew Meat

Dry aged and cubed beef roast. 

ROAST CUTS

Chuck Roast

Fatty and flavorful roast cut from the shoulder. 

Seven Roast

Seven roast comes from the same area as the chuck roast and has comparable marbling and structure.

Rump Roast

Great versatile cut of lean beef. Slow roast it in the oven or turn it into beef jerky!

Marrow Bones

Canoe cut marrow bones are a great source of nutrients. Use it in a broth or spread it on toast! 

BONES + OFFAL CUTS

Knuckle Collagen Bones

These beef bones are full of collagen and nutrients that are perfect for  bone broth!

*3 lb. average

Oxtail 

The perfect mixture of beef and collagen. Great slow-cooked or in a stew.

Cheek Meat

Braise the cheek meat low and slow for a really tender and flavorful cut of beef.

Heart 

A very nutrient dense cut of beef, packed with iron and protein! Pan-fry or grill and slice it up! Or try it in the slow-cooker to add to a stew. 

Tongue 

A beef delicacy! Slow-cooked beef tongue can make juicy and tender tacos or served sliced as-is.

Ground Beef - 90/10 Blend

90% lean, 10% fat. Cleaner, richer, more nutrient dense than your usual ground beef. Dry aged, so it's always soft and tender. 

We process one steer at a time, so the ground beef is never a mixture of multiple animals.

GROUND BEEF + SAUSAGE

Ground Beef - 80/20 Blend

80% lean, 20% fat. 

Hamburger Patties

Six patties included (totaling 2 lbs.)

85% lean, 15% fat. 

All-Beef Snack Sticks

Original Flavored Beef snack stick, great for on the go!

Ingredients: Beef, Spices, Salt, Citric Acid, Garlic, Celery Powder

*Refrigerate after opening

All-Beef Garlic Sausage

Four sausages included (totaling 1 lb.)

All beef smoked garlic sausage. No nitrates or nitrates. 

Ingredients: Beef, Water, Salt, Spices, Seasoning, Celery Powder, Brown Sugar, Cherry Powder, *Pork Casing

Hot Dogs

Five hot dogs included (totaling 1 lb.)

All natural grass fed beef, clean pork fat from 840 Farm.

Ingredients: Beef, Pork Fat, Water, Salt, Spices, *Sodium Nitrite, Celery Powder, Cherry Powder, Garlic Powder, Onion Powder 

Tallow Soap

Small batch, handmade grass fed & finished tallow soap.

Ingredients:Tallow, organic coconut oil, raw unrefined shea butter, distilled water, lye, essential oils, and natural coloring.

TALLOW + HONEY + EGGS

Tallow Body Butter

Unscented soft body butter made from Pure Grass Fed Grass Finished Tallow. 

Ingredients: Tallow, Organic Raw Shea butter, Mango Butter, Castor Oil, Jojoba Oil

Honey

Harvested on the ranch, showcasing a range of flavors from the flowers and forage across the land!

*Seasonal

Fresh Ranch Eggs

Free Range Chickens. Easter eggs, olive eggs, and barnyard mix.

The Importance of Omega-3 Fatty Acids

Cardiovascular Health

Lowers triglycerides – reduces blood fat levels, decreasing risk of heart disease.

Reduces blood pressure (modestly, especially in hypertensive individuals).

Improves vascular function – keeps arteries flexible, reducing stiffness.

Anti-Inflammatory Effects

Omega-3s are precursors to resolvins and protectins, molecules that reduce chronic inflammation.

May benefit autoimmune conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis, lupus, and inflammatory bowel disease by reducing joint pain and stiffness.

Brain & Mental Health

Supports cognitive function – DHA (docosahexaenoic acid) is a major structural fat in the brain and retina.

Neuroprotection – may reduce risk of age-related cognitive decline and Alzheimer’s disease.

Pregnancy & Development

Essential for fetal brain and eye development.

Supplementation during pregnancy and breastfeeding is linked to better neuro-developmental outcomes in children.

1961

Founded in 1961, we are a 3rd generation family owned and operated beef cattle ranch. 

We didn't know what else to say about ourselves.

Then, one week before the 3rd generation started work at the ranch, our ranch manager wrote this:

Looking at the ranch from my perspective:

This place is a unique piece of art that continues to evolve.  Almost as if you paint a picture today and tomorrow you resurface your canvas with a new one. These pictures will continuously create new thoughts, it often sheds light of hope and inspiration, can bring you joy, and sometimes frustration. Frustration grows when trying to resist the flow of nature as society encourages us to do. You have to remember just as the seasons change the mood of the ranch does as well.  

As humans we have the ability to adjust and cope to our environment and for me that is the only way to survive out here.  I say this for simply the fact that it takes someone with determination, self motivation, and a deep understanding to thrive here.  

The family displays a deep passion for this place and its future.  Passion may not be felt at first glance, but I believe passion for this place grows along the way. Just as the canvas gets thicker with each new painting, the roots of the ranch grow deeper and stronger within you.  

As manager I would be thrilled to have the next generation as a part of the team to keep the canvas together.

We hope to share our passion with you.
